systematicIssues: identity_clash treats two empty identity sets as 'no contradiction', so a row whose name carries no family marker (e.g. 'Madurai Medical College, Madurai') can never be vetoed, while the CORRECT family row is vetoed by the `not ia or not ib` branch. This is the mechanism behind both 200580 (AIIMS Madurai -> Madurai MC) and 904551 (ESIC Varanasi -> IMS-BHU). Fix: any family token present on the cell side (AIIMS / ESIC / GMERS / DENTAL / NURSING / AYURVED / autonomous-state) must be REQUIRED on the row side; an empty row identity is a veto, not a pass.

The proposer is blind to our own duplicate clusters. 46 of 321 targets are a duplicate twin: 39 point at the later-added shadow batch (_id prefix 6a61b3d6, 182 rows that shadow the 6a550a1d canonical rows) and 5 targets are named in data/out/stale_duplicate_colleges.json. Whichever twin gets the mccCode, the other keeps its closingRanks/fees children and becomes an orphan cluster. Rule to add: refuse to propose when >=2 same-state rows score >=0.8 against each other, when the target name is in stale_duplicate_colleges.json, or when the target _id is in the shadow batch — emit a merge task instead.

Town evidence is taken from the full postal address rather than the institute-name segment, so 'town_in_cell' passes on a NEIGHBOURING district's name: GMC Barmer vs 'NH-15 Jaisalmer Road', GMC Hingoli vs 'Washim Road', GMC Kodangal vs 'Vikarabad District', GMC Maheshwaram vs 'Rangareddy', GMC Baramulla vs 'Jammu and Kashmir'. No sector or course-family constraint. Private-vs-government on the same city passes freely (902812 Graphic Era private -> Doon government; 904744 Sikkim state GMC -> private SMIMS). Require colleges.type agreement and MEDICAL/DENTAL/NURSING agreement before a proposal is emitted — the medical-vs-dental-on-one-campus trap is only being caught by luck.

Rows that are not 1:1 institutes are still proposable: seat-type-split rows ('MGM Medical College, Aurangabad — Management/Paid seats' / '— NRI seats') and campus-split families (MGM Kamothe/Nerul/Vashi/Panvel; KMC Manipal/Mangalore; SRM Ramapuram/Kattankulathur) cannot carry a single institute code.
